_comment: ChangeGuard Plan V3 Work Package E4: Class-Aware Interventions Screening Configuration

mask_provenance.sar_valid_mask_description: Binary sensory raster recording physical SAR observation validity (1=valid, 0=nodata). Strictly independent of ground-truth labels.
mask_provenance.label_description: Ground truth annotation raster (3=unannotated/invalid, 2=flood, 0,1=other land cover).
mask_provenance.adaptation_mask_definition: valid = (MK0_MNA == 1). Strictly NO ground-truth labels and NO label-3 exclusion during adaptation.
mask_provenance.offline_evaluation_mask_definition: valid = (MK0_MNA == 1) & (MK0_MLU != 3). Strictly evaluated offline on frozen predictions.

screening_cells.name: Fixed Unmodified Base (E2_CONF_90)
screening_cells.description: Retained E2 base consistency recipe with confidence threshold tau=0.90, horizontal-flip strong augmentation, zero auxiliary loss.

screening_cells.name: K1: Class-Balanced Confidence Selection
screening_cells.description: Imposes uniform batch-level quota cap = floor(N_eligible / 3) across candidate predicted classes with deterministic lexicographical tie-breaking. Empty classes receive zero and unused quota is not transferred.

screening_cells.name: K2: Flood-Aware Adaptation Loss Weighting
screening_cells.description: Applies source-calibrated inverse frequency flood weighting (w_flood=4.0) inside adaptation loss denominator, preserving full prediction coverage.

screening_cells.name: K3: Source-Predicted Permanent-Water Exclusion
screening_cells.description: Excludes pixels predicted as permanent water (class 1, frozen-source argmax) from consistency adaptation loss. Does not guarantee invariant candidate predictions because shared affine parameters adapt.

screening_cells.name: K4: Frozen-Source Flood/Change Preservation
screening_cells.description: Applies auxiliary loss penalty (lambda=0.50) on candidate strong predictions where frozen source predicted flood (p_src(2) >= 0.50).
